leadText:
Gardenia Town (Japanese: アベリアタウン Abelia Town) is an -exclusive location in the Kanto region. Among the town's attractions is a Contest Hall, attracting many Pokémon Coordinators who wish to compete in the Kanto Grand Festival. It was first mentioned in Curbing the Crimson Tide!, in which discovered that a Pokémon Contest was scheduled to be held there.

 and arrived in Gardenia Town in What I Did for Love!. May was excited at the chance to add the coveted Gardenia Ribbon to her collection, and decided to her for its stage debut. When a girl named appeared looking for the registration desk, Eevee popped out of the ground and knocked her over, revealing it had learned . After that, gave her the directions and she took off.

Later, an experienced by the name of Yuma appeared and complimented Brock's Bonsly. Brock, trying to impress her, sent out and showed her the Pokéblock he gives his . Yuma then asked Brock if he competes in Pokémon Contests and revealed that she is a Top Coordinator who wants to pass her techniques on to beginning Coordinators. Hearing this, Brock ran to the Contest Hall to get a Contest Pass and register for the Gardenia Contest.

In the Performance Stage, May had creating a pyramid of s and freezing it with , while Mollie displayed her 's ability to grind a log with . Brock started his performance by commanding Bonsly to use before throwing in the air so Bonsly could juggle them with . They all managed to impress the panel of judges enough to advance to the second round.

During the Battle Stage, Brock was matched against Mollie, using his Marshtomp to battle her . He won the battle and quickly made his way to the finals, where he found himself up against May. Brock proved to be a tough opponent for May, as Marshtomp was able to sense Eevee's underground movements with its fins. However, May was able to take advantage of several dirt mounds to evade Brock's attacks and land a few hits, lowering Brock's points in the process. When time ran out, it was shown that May had more points than Brock, and thus, Lilian announced May as the winner of the Gardenia Contest. This victory gave May her fourth Kanto Ribbon.
